story.text: 승객 여러분, 이번엔 도심 속 자연, '북한산' 상공을 지나갑니다. 산소가 가득한 공기를 느껴보세요.
story.reading: seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun, i-beon-en do-sim sok ja-yeon, buk-han-san sang-gong-eul ji-na-gam-ni-da.
story.en: Passengers, we're now flying over 'Bukhansan', nature in the heart of the city. Feel the fresh, oxygen-rich air.

story.text: 서울 시민들은 주말마다 '등산'을 즐겨요. 도심에서 이렇게 가까운 명산이 있다는 게 큰 행운이죠.
story.en: Seoul citizens love 'hiking' every weekend. It's a real blessing to have such a fine mountain so close to downtown.

story.text: 산자락에는 조선시대에 쌓은 '성곽'이 있어요. 한양도성 성곽길을 따라 역사를 걸을 수 있죠.
story.en: On the mountain's foot, there's a 'fortress wall' built in the Joseon era. You can walk through history along the Hanyang Fortress trail.

story.text: 힘들게 올라가면 '정상'에서 서울 전체가 한눈에 보이는 보상을 받아요.
story.reading: him-deul-ge ol-la-ga-myeon jeong-sang-e-seo seo-ul jeon-che-ga han-nun-e bo-i-neun bo-sang-eul bad-a-yo.
story.en: If you push through the climb, you're rewarded with a view of all of Seoul at once from the 'summit'.

story.text: 체력에 자신이 없다면 평평한 '둘레길'을 걸어도 좋아요. 숲의 향기만으로도 힐링이 되니까요.
story.reading: che-ryeog-e ja-sin-i eop-da-myeon pyeong-pyeong-han dul-le-gil-eul geol-eo-do jo-a-yo.
story.en: If you're not confident in your stamina, walking the flat 'loop trail' is also great — the scent of the forest alone is healing.

story.text: 맑은 공기 많이 마셨나요? 이제 산행에서 배운 단어로 문제를 풀어볼 시간이에요!
story.en: Did you breathe in plenty of fresh air? Now it's time to solve some questions with the words from our hike!

words.example_en: I could see people climbing the rock face.
I often go hiking on weekends.
I walk along the Hanyang Fortress trail.
You can see all of Seoul from the summit.
It's nice to slowly walk the loop trail.

sentences.en: Bukhansan is beautiful in all four seasons.
Hiking makes both body and mind healthier.
Walking along the fortress wall, you feel the history.
Reaching the summit brings a great sense of achievement.
The loop trail is easy walking for people of all ages.
